gold_note: Theropod braincase tree, read by eye. Averostra is a three-way node (Sinosaurus, Ceratosauria, Tetanurae). NEOTHEROPODA, AVEROSTRA, CERATOSAURIA and TETANURAE label nodes and are kept; SAUROPODOMORPHA and COELUROSAURIA sit on the terminal branches of Plateosaurus and Alioramus and are not encoded. The braincase images are not tips. 12 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 8 case (census 2, seed 20261251). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
